messages.subject: For Shailesh Jejurikar | Global affairs, sustainability and emerging-market execution
messages.body:
Dear P&G Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Shailesh G. Jejurikar, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer.

P&G's global consumer platform requires disciplined alignment across governments, communities, sustainability priorities and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex cross-functional stakeholder matters across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of global affairs, government relations and emerging-market execution might support P&G's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Procter & Gamble.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
